meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: 数据科学家与产品经理在向高管汇报或制作投资者演示时，当面临数据枯燥难懂的痛点，使用此技能可套用“Setup-Conflict-Resolution”叙事框架，自动生成结合可视化与业务上下文的洞察报告，让非技术受众秒懂结论并驱动决策。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将枯燥数据转化为驱动决策的清晰叙事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要把数据结论清晰传达给非技术决策者
copy.tagline_en: Turn dull data into decision-driving stories for non-technical audiences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain data insights to non-technical stakeholders and drive decisions

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把原始数据套用 Setup→Conflict→Resolution 叙事框架，产出含可视化、业务上下文与行动建议的洞察报告，让非技术受众看懂结论。
howto.when: 当你向高管汇报、做季度业务回顾或准备投资者演示，需要把数据讲给非技术受众听时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这份客户流失数据讲成一个故事
把这份季度指标做成高管汇报用的叙事幻灯片
say.note: 按六段叙事弧给出各页内容

say.text: 比较 EMEA 和 APAC，给出先进入哪个市场的建议
say.note: 用对比故事框架加权重打分

howto.what_en: Claude turns raw data into a Setup-Conflict-Resolution narrative, producing insight reports that combine visuals, business context and recommendations for non-technical audiences.
howto.when_en: Use it when presenting analytics to executives, preparing quarterly business reviews or investor decks, or explaining data to non-technical audiences.

say_en.text: Turn this customer churn data into a story
Build a narrative deck from these quarterly metrics
Compare EMEA and APAC and recommend which to enter first
say_en.note: Uses the comparison framework with scoring
